name: Steam
tagline: The ultimate destination for playing, discussing, and creating games.
description: Steam is the ultimate destination for playing, discussing, and creating games.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/steam:version-0779c5e2@sha256:ed97628a6943b103e3f2ff617c6ceb9062db16cebab6cf71e42a1ceb5ea0cff5
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
